site.name: aurora-network
site.summary: Aurora Network — Privacy & Audience (local demo) Fictional social network. Local fixture for UXBench. Open `index.html` directly in a browser. Pages `index.html` — Privacy overview Entry hub. Four cards (Default audience, Tag review, Past post visibility, Muted words) link to each privacy-management surface. Below the cards, a "Snapshot" panel summarizes the user's current privacy state as a key/value list. `audience.html` — Default audience Radio-group selector with four options (Public, Friends, Custom list, Only me). Below the selector: dynamic explanation of who can see new posts, custom-list manager (create / inspect / view recent use), and a "Who can tag you?" radio block. `tag-review.html` — Pending tag queue

run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the Aurora Network privacy settings, focusing on the flow from the overview dashboard to specific configuration pages (Audience, Tags, History, Muted Words), validating state changes, feedback loops, and mobile responsiveness.
run_plan.summary: The run will begin at the Privacy Overview hub, verifying the 'Snapshot' panel accuracy. It will then systematically traverse the four primary privacy modules: configuring Default Audience (including custom lists), processing the Tag Review queue, testing Past Post Visibility filters, and managing Muted Words. Each phase includes validation of UI feedback and error states, concluding with a mobile viewport check for touch target accessibility given the prescan warnings.
assumptions: The 'Change' links in the Snapshot panel on index.html route directly to the relevant sub-pages or open modals.
Actions taken on sub-pages (e.g., changing audience) may require a page reload or navigation back to index.html to reflect in the Snapshot summary.
The 'Custom list' manager on audience.html allows for creation/inspection without leaving the page context.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (<44px) identified in prescan across all pages (mobile risk).
Past post visibility bulk actions (potential for irreversible data loss if UX is unclear).
Tag review queue management (efficiency of bulk approve/hide vs individual actions).
State synchronization between sub-pages and the Index.html Snapshot panel.

phases.title: Overview & Navigation Baseline
phases.objective: Validate the entry point, information architecture, and the accuracy of the 'Snapshot' summary panel.
key_checks: Verify all 4 privacy cards link to correct destinations.
Check 'Snapshot' panel values match expected defaults (e.g., Audience: Friends).
Test 'Change' links in the Snapshot panel for correct routing.
Assess visual hierarchy between 'Privacy' and 'Notifications' sections.
exit_criteria: All primary navigation links verified working.

phases.title: Default Audience Configuration
phases.objective: Explore the complexity of audience selection, specifically the 'Custom list' logic and radio button interactions.
key_checks: Toggle through all 4 radio options (Public, Friends, Custom, Only Me).
Verify dynamic explanation text updates correctly for each option.
Interact with 'Custom list' manager: inspect existing lists (Close friends, Work circle).
Test 'Who can tag you?' secondary control block.
Attempt to save/discard changes to observe feedback mechanisms.

phases.title: Tag Review Workflow
phases.objective: Evaluate the efficiency of the moderation queue for pending tags.
key_checks: Review the 7 pending items for content clarity (who tagged, context).
Test individual actions: Approve, Hide tag, Block user.
Test bulk actions: 'Approve all' and 'Hide all'.
Verify if 'Block user' triggers a confirmation dialog or immediate action.
Check for empty state messaging after clearing the queue.
exit_criteria: At least one individual action performed.

phases.title: Historical Data & Bulk Actions
phases.objective: Assess the safety and clarity of the 'Past post visibility' bulk editing tool.
key_checks: Test year filter dropdowns (2019-2026).
Test audience filter (Public only, Friends only, etc.).
Verify the 'Apply to visible' button state (disabled/enabled) based on selections.
Look for warning modals or confirmations before applying bulk changes.
Check if the timeline view provides enough context for decision making.
exit_criteria: Safety mechanisms for bulk actions identified.

phases.title: Muted Words Management
phases.objective: Validate the input methods and scope definitions for content filtering.
key_checks: Test adding a new word/phrase via input field.
Test removing an existing word (e.g., 'spoiler').
Verify 'Import .txt' and 'Export .txt' buttons (file picker interaction).
Review the 'Where do these apply?' section for clarity on exemptions (DMs).
Check for case-sensitivity or hashtag handling explanations.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Accessibility
phases.objective: Re-evaluate critical flows on mobile viewport, specifically targeting the prescan's 'small tap target' warnings.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport (e.g., iPhone SE/Pixel 5).
Attempt to tap 'Change' links in Snapshot panel (verify precision required).
Test radio button selection on Audience page (touch friendliness).
Check Tag Review card actions (Approve/Hide) for overlap or mis-taps.
Verify navigation menu collapse/expansion behavior if applicable.
exit_criteria: Critical paths usable on mobile despite small targets.
Specific usability issues documented for reporting.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 5 HTML files (index, audience, tag-review, past-posts, blocked-words).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all radio groups, bulk action buttons, filter dropdowns, and list management controls.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat Phases 1, 2, and 3 on mobile viewport to validate touch targets.

notes: Prescan indicates no JS errors, but layout warnings suggest significant mobile usability risks due to <44px tap targets.
The 'Snapshot' on index.html is a key feedback loop; always return there after making changes to verify persistence.
Past post visibility involves 'irreversible' bulk actions; look closely for undo mechanisms or strong warnings.
